name: Almatret (Spain)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the back of a white right hand with a black scalloped cuff.
history: The official flag of Almatret is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light blue, with the back of the white right hand dressed with a black scalloped cuff of five curved teeth from the arms, 7/9 of the height of the cloth, at the centre; approved on 5 June 2009 and published in the DOGC on 22 June 2009.

features.role: scalloped cuff of five curved teeth
